details:
NASA Space Simulator: An Interactive Adventure Through the Universe

NASA Space Simulator is an educational and interactive project designed to make space exploration engaging, accessible, and fun. It combines a website created with Landbot and an immersive video game developed in Unity, allowing users to explore the universe, discover planets, and learn about the mysteries of space.

The experience begins on our Landbot website, where users can discover information about planets, the galaxy, and space exploration. Then, they enter the Unity game, where they take control of a spacecraft and embark on an interactive expedition. Throughout the journey, players must make important decisions, face different space challenges, and solve problems to progress through their mission. Their choices influence the direction of the adventure, making each experience more engaging and participatory.

The main benefit of the project is that it transforms scientific information into an interactive learning experience. Instead of simply reading about space, users can explore it through gameplay, visual storytelling, and decision-making. Our goal is to encourage curiosity, develop problem-solving skills, promote interest in science and technology, and make astronomy more accessible, especially to younger generations.

We used NASA data and educational resources to support the scientific content, Blender for 3D modeling and visual development, Sketchfab for 3D assets, Unity as the main game development platform, and Landbot to create the interactive website. We also incorporated artificial intelligence tools such as Codex, Gemini AI, and ChatGPT to support development, creativity, and problem-solving.

The creative aspect of NASA Space Simulator lies in combining a conversational website with an interactive space adventure, connecting education, gaming, and technology in a single experience. We focused on creating an engaging visual environment, intuitive interactions, meaningful player choices, and educational challenges while considering scientific accuracy, accessibility, usability, and the overall user experience.

Our expected impact is to inspire people to learn more about the universe, strengthen their interest in space exploration, and demonstrate how technology and creativity can transform education into an exciting adventure.
